resolved_findings: The combination editor shared a Boolean focus across name and notes; clearing the name did not reliably select its field. Replaced it with distinct field focus and validated rename, save and relaunch.

At accessibility XXXL, invalid servings left the keyboard open and the error below a long form. Confirmation now resigns focus and places the error beside the servings input; targeted full large-dark combination flow passed in batch 3.
scenarios_checked: Rapid repeated meal confirmation: MainActor busy guard and cached prepared UUID batch; repository retries are idempotent and partial or revised replays reject.
Food-directory label upgrades retain persisted nutrients, units and historical snapshots; original 300 values and all 500 official values were compared.
Atomic meal dependencies, diary records and Health intents roll back together on failure; disk reopen and backup v1/v2 round trips covered by tests.
Empty, duplicated-ID, 51-item, zero-serving and scaled-overflow inputs reject before persistence; example preview and cancellation never write.
residual_risks: New original nutrition content is in Chinese; some food names remain English.
JSON format 2 is readable by 1.3; older app versions cannot restore new-format backups.
testing_gaps: No new physical-device HealthKit, minimum-iOS-18, real VoiceOver or lock-screen notification acceptance is claimed.
